harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Installed a root crontab entry on node1 that runs /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance daily at 02:15, appending stdout/stderr to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log. Verified the command executes correctly and writes to the log. Performed the mandatory single-node restart evidence protocol: captured baseline boot_id and service/data state, issued a native reboot (shutdown -r now) whose acknowledgement returned before disconnection, polled until node1 was reachable again, and confirmed the boot_id changed (8336c3a1... -> bb225e25...) along with recovered cron service (active), persisted root crontab entry, and intact log file/content post-restart.
actions_performed: Inspected /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance script and confirmed sudo access on node1
Manually invoked the cron command line to verify it appends correctly to the log
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id, uptime, cron service status, crontab contents, log contents
Issued backgrounded 'shutdown -r now' on node1 so the ack returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again (first poll got SSH connection refused, second poll succeeded)
Captured post-restart state: new boot_id, new uptime_since, cron active, crontab entry persisted, log file intact

evidence.requirement: Cron job configured to run /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance daily at 02:15 on node1
evidence.summary: Root crontab installed with entry '15 2 * * * /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance >> /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log 2>&1' and listed back to confirm
Manually ran the exact cron command line; log file received the script's output line
Captured boot_id, uptime_since, cron active status, root crontab contents, and log contents before restart
Backgrounded 'shutdown -r now' via nohup; command returned REBOOT_ACK_ISSUED immediately

evidence.requirement: Node became unreachable then recovered (proof of actual restart)
evidence.summary: First poll failed with SSH connection refused (node down), second poll succeeded (node back up)

evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proving restart occurred
evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id (bb225e25-8637-4655-995a-fae1c1651877) differs from baseline boot_id (8336c3a1-91fc-4135-b26a-5d2863cb2594); uptime_since also updated to the new boot time

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of cron service, crontab config, and log data
evidence.summary: After restart, cron service is active, root crontab entry persisted unchanged, and /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log retained its prior content
